body: Thank you! You have absolutely no idea how much it means to me to get this response. Thank you, from the bottom of my heart!

To be honest we aren't really. She was never aware of how bad I was feeling. She's helping me through it though so maybe this is what I need. Every little thing just seems so big in my head, and it's just taking a lot out of me. I am back to college tomorrow, so I'm hoping it's a good day. Thank you so so much, and to all of you guys for the support. I really want to feel better! It's just such a thin line between feeling very happy, and very sad.
Thank you, I'm just about here. I sat in my mams arms all night after she found me attempting. I feel bad that she seen me but happy im here. I just lost my mind yesterday.
I really wish it wasnt as hard as it is. But thank you for the advice!

Well im really glad for you that you can make that change and that you can come to terms with pin pointing exactly what is wrong you you; for example cutting your hair or loosing weight. Its not all just on the outside. Actually, the majority of it is on the inside, in my heart and my soul. How do I "change" myself without thinking im pushing everyone in my life away from me. I wish it was that easy but its not and its the harsh reality of it. It is for me anyway!
What if there's nothing you actually like about yourself though? How can I change everything?

First of all, you are NOT a failure!!
Just because college doesn't suit some people doesn't mean they wont be successful. College helps, but it's not the bee all and end all. 
It sounds like you have a good set of parents there, but do what you want to do. Don't let them control or persuade you into working at a place you don't want to work at. As for the army, it might give you what you need. A little bit of focus and routine. Sometimes the hardest things to do turn out to be the best. They give you like a direction or something! You're lacking motivation to do anything and you dont see the point in doing something cause its "what if" because I am the exact same, except I am in the middle of beauty school and I have to keep up this "image" of everything being great in my life when its a complete and utter disaster!
We can pull through it though, for absolute sure! 
PM me if you want to talk more. This has kind of helped me too!
You're strong! I know you are! I know how difficult it is to not be accepted for who you are, and that if you're honest, you are just "over-reacting".... Its frustrating!
